entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Order number is 99C-415.

Certainly, I can look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order 99C-415... Okay, I see it here. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It's just not what I wanted. Look, I know it's been a couple of weeks, but we had a major family emergency.
I understand. Can you tell me what happened?

My son's overseas deployment got moved up unexpectedly, and right before he was supposed to leave, he needed emergency surgery. I've basically been living at the hospital, and this is the first moment I've had to deal with personal things. So, can you process the return or not?
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I certainly hope he has a swift recovery. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date. Please hold for one moment.
Alright, I've reviewed the VeloFit return policy. It shows here that your purchase is still well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Okay, good. What do I need to do?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Simply place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
I see the email now. Thank you.
You are most welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Okay. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and please send our best wishes to your son for a quick recovery before his deployment. Have a good day.
